title: Protective Styles for Growth
summary: Braids, twists and buns can help you keep length. How to care for your scalp while you wear them.
body:
Protective styling gives your hair a break from daily manipulation. Low-tension braids, twists and buns help you retain length.

## Box braids maintenance

Keep your scalp moisturized with a light oil and sleep in a satin bonnet to prevent frizz. Don't leave them in too long, or the roots can mat.
